## Summary

> Spatial ridged multifractal noise: octaves of inverted absolute basis noise
> offset by Offset (typically 1), producing sharp ridge crests. Suited to
> mountainous terrain and vein-like structures
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multifractal\_system).
